speaker: Doctor
text: Welcome to the clinic. I see you have a longstanding pruritic rash accompanied by numbness and tingling on your palms. To begin, how long have you been experiencing these symptoms, and does the rash appear symmetrically on both hands?

speaker: Patient
text: 50-year-old male. The patient reports a year-long history of an itchy rash on his upper body and face. Additionally, he has been experiencing a numbness and tingling sensation on both palms. He has been working on his family's rice farm, also caring for livestock.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Scabies.

Thank you for the details; the year-long history, itching on the upper body and face, combined with palm involvement and your occupation on a rice farm with livestock, strongly suggests scabies infestation. Are you currently experiencing any burning sensations in the palms or night sweats?
